first_error_signature: The MSP430X core exists, but the MSP430x5xx modules this part needs (SFR block at 0x0100, PMM, UCS, USCI_A at 0x05C0, WDT_A, MPY32) are not modelled; the chip declares `arch: unknown` and is refused. No firmware run was attempted.
failure_hint: Model the x5xx SFR/PMM/UCS/USCI_A/WDT_A modules and narrow the descriptor to them before adding a smoke; do not reuse the x2xx module addresses.
